title: Science Project Meaning & Equation Guide — 2026-09-12
status: project-wide reader and research-value layer; does not change the evidentiary status of parent theories
abstract: This guide raises the explanatory standard of the Tim Dooley science archive by treating an equation as valuable only when a reader can tell what problem it solves, what each symbol represents, which assumptions make it meaningful, what observable or formal consequence follows, and what result would falsify, downgrade or supersede it. The strongest records already do this: UPT separates recovered history from modern EFT repair; the dimensional Door separates order parameter, spectral dimension and genuine 5D geometry; Potato Dynamics turns Axis, Door and Eye into typed dynamical objects; and Door/Handshake distinguishes network nonlocality from quantum nonlocality. This record propagates that discipline across the major project families. It is not a new Theory of Everything but a scientific reading and advancement contract: abstracts state the precise question and maturity, equations receive variable/type/assumption/interpretation notes, speculative mappings stay distinct from established science, and every project identifies the smallest next calculation or experiment capable of materially changing its status.
research_question: How can every science project in the archive become more informative to a technically literate reader without inflating speculative material into established science?
core_rule: Every added paragraph or equation should reduce ambiguity, increase calculability, improve observable linkage, expose an assumption, sharpen a comparison baseline, or create a real failure test. Decorative algebra and ontology growth are negative value.

reader_contract.abstract: State the scientific object, exact question, strongest current result, maturity and largest unresolved gap.
reader_contract.equation_context: For every central equation give variables, units/types, role, assumptions, limiting case, interpretation and at least one consequence.
reader_contract.separation: Keep established external science, recovered Tim material, archive-generated formalization and speculative interpretation distinguishable.
reader_contract.comparison: Name the simpler or established baseline that must be beaten before special terminology earns explanatory necessity.
reader_contract.advancement: Name the smallest calculation, dataset, derivation or experiment that could materially advance or reject the model.
reader_contract.failure: State when the model or interpretation should be downgraded rather than reinterpreted after the fact.

equation_explanation_template.equation: Write the expression exactly enough to calculate with it.
equation_explanation_template.variables: Define every symbol and distinguish state variables, parameters, observables and coordinates.
equation_explanation_template.units_and_types: State units/dimensions or explicitly say dimensionless.
equation_explanation_template.role: Say whether it is a definition, law, ansatz, estimator, constraint, transition rule, likelihood or comparator.
equation_explanation_template.assumptions: List conditions under which it is valid.
equation_explanation_template.plain_language: Explain what changes when important terms increase/decrease.
equation_explanation_template.limiting_case: Show a familiar or simpler limit where possible.
equation_explanation_template.observable_consequence: Connect it to something measurable, simulatable or formally checkable.
equation_explanation_template.failure_condition: State what outcome shows the expression or interpretation is inadequate.

project_guides.meaning: Candidate EFT programme asking whether the recovered Potato-sector action can be completed consistently and distinguished from ordinary GR + Standard Model extensions.
project_guides.equation_meaning: The expression is a ledger of dynamical sectors; the real work is defining P/K, deriving spectrum/vacuum/interactions and showing a new prediction.
project_guides.next_step: Choose one minimal field-content fork, define the nonlocal operator, derive spectrum/stability and constrain one observable sector.
project_guides.downgrade_if: Inconsistent, experimentally excluded or observationally redundant with a simpler EFT.

project_guides.meaning: BSM model-selection problem: neutral scalar versus charged complex field, followed by vacuum, spectrum and observable derivation.
project_guides.equation_meaning: The off-diagonal term controls Higgs–Potato mixing; nonzero mixing changes masses and couplings.
project_guides.next_step: Freeze one representation, solve vacuum/mass matrix and confront collider/cosmology constraints.
project_guides.downgrade_if: No stable allowed region or no discriminating prediction beyond generic singlet/U(1) models.

project_guides.meaning: Strong-gravity bifurcation programme asking whether a GR-like branch becomes unstable and a new effective branch appears.
project_guides.equation_meaning: Xi controls the regime and phi labels the branch; a mass-sign change can generate a transition but does not prove literal 5D spacetime.
project_guides.next_step: Derive one instability threshold, nonlinear branch and strong-gravity observable against GR/scalarization baselines.
project_guides.downgrade_if: No stable branch or all effects are degenerate with simpler modified gravity.

project_guides.meaning: Inverse-problem/information programme asking what lower-dimensional descriptions preserve, discard and reconstruct.
project_guides.equation_focus: Use reconstruction loss, I(Z;X|Y), Bayes-risk loss and Blackwell ordering together.
project_guides.equation_meaning: A projection may lose microscopic detail while preserving everything needed for a target decision; information theory alone does not establish physical extra dimensions.
project_guides.next_step: Solve one explicit projection/reconstruction problem and quantify task sufficiency.
project_guides.downgrade_if: Dimensions are added without a map, action, spectrum or measurable reduction problem.

project_guides.meaning: Typed hybrid/open-system grammar for flow, structural transformation, observations, thresholds, resets and reduction.
project_guides.equation_meaning: F is temporal flow, A structural/scale flow, and the bracket measures whether their order matters; Door maps govern discrete events.
project_guides.next_step: Instantiate one empirical system and estimate/test F, A, observations and transitions against a smaller baseline.
project_guides.downgrade_if: The master tuple grows without an application or a reduced model preserves the same observables.

project_guides.meaning: Control/dynamical translation: Axis=flow, Eye=observation map, Door=event/reset operator.
project_guides.equation_focus: y=O(x), xdot=F(x), x+=D(x-) on guard h(x)=0.
project_guides.equation_meaning: Separates hidden state, measured output and regime-changing events, making observability and first-passage/hysteresis questions calculable.
project_guides.next_step: Build one simulator/dataset application and test hidden-state reconstruction through Door events.
project_guides.downgrade_if: Axis is called a physical dimension without metric/action or thresholds lack measurable rules.

project_guides.meaning: Exact logarithmic-spiral geometry testable against alternative curve families.
project_guides.equation_meaning: A quarter-turn multiplies radius by phi; this is an exact geometric consequence, not evidence for a universal mechanism.
project_guides.next_step: Fit target coordinates with uncertainty against free logarithmic, Archimedean, power-law and spline baselines.
project_guides.downgrade_if: The golden constraint fits worse or is chosen post hoc.

project_guides.meaning: Source→channel→storage→release framework reusable across typed stock-flow domains.
project_guides.equation_meaning: Input fills the store; release and loss drain it; eta+Gamma fixes the response timescale.
project_guides.next_step: Calibrate one real domain, close the stock-flow ledger and test held-out response data.
project_guides.downgrade_if: A fundamental force is inferred without force law/source charge or hidden stores lack identifiable timescales.

project_guides.meaning: Latent-state measurement programme rather than fixed mystical frequencies or mixed-unit consciousness scores.
project_guides.equation_focus: HMM/HSMM/state-space likelihood plus Fisher/profile-likelihood identifiability diagnostics.
project_guides.equation_meaning: Tests whether recurring latent regimes explain longitudinal measurements and whether those regimes/parameters can actually be recovered.
project_guides.next_step: Choose one operational target, predefine measurements, compare with simple baselines and test recovery/replication.
project_guides.downgrade_if: States are unstable/non-identifiable while still receiving strong substantive labels.

project_guides.meaning: Multiscale causal programme from tubulin/polymer dynamics through cells/circuits to behavior, with a separate quantum-necessity gate.
project_guides.equation_focus: M q¨+Gamma q˙+Kq=xi(t); candidate quantum rho˙=-(i/hbar)[H,rho]+L_decoh[rho].
project_guides.equation_meaning: Classical dynamics must be measured first; quantum language earns necessity only via a quantum-specific observable and downstream causal effect unexplained classically.
project_guides.next_step: Measure classical modes/couplings and selective downstream neural effects before quantum-specific tests.
project_guides.downgrade_if: Effects disappear under cytoskeletal/toxicity controls or quantum models add no predictive value.

project_guides.meaning: 3D statistical morphology hypothesis using invariant descriptors/nulls rather than visual resemblance.
project_guides.equation_focus: Axis ratios, Minkowski/shapefinder topology and shear invariants J2=1/2 tr(sigma^2), J3=det(sigma).
project_guides.equation_meaning: Magnitude, eigenvalue shape, topology and orientation are different properties and should not collapse into one 'potato-looking' judgment.
project_guides.next_step: Freeze one segmentation pipeline and test a predeclared classifier against ellipsoid/filament/sheet/simulation nulls.
project_guides.downgrade_if: Result depends strongly on view angle, segmentation or post-hoc target selection.

project_guides.meaning: Container for comparing real cosmological descendants without turning metaphorical commonality into physical identity.
project_guides.equation_focus: For Q=xi H rho_c, r=rho_c/rho_de obeys r'=r[3w+xi(1+r)].
project_guides.equation_meaning: The ratio equation tests whether a matter/dark-energy balance is a stable attractor; a formal fixed point is insufficient if unstable or unphysical.
project_guides.next_step: Choose one descendant, derive background+perturbations, check stability and fit expansion/growth/lensing jointly.
project_guides.downgrade_if: Dark matter and dark energy are called one substance solely because the metaphor groups them.

project_guides.meaning: Temporal-network model separating edge formation, influence, homophily and common exposure.
project_guides.equation_focus: P(e_ij=1|Z_ij)=sigma(beta_0+beta^T Z_ij), followed by declared contagion/hazard dynamics.
project_guides.equation_meaning: Pair features predict coupling formation; later dynamics test propagation. Similarity before connection must not be mistaken for influence.
project_guides.next_step: Freeze a temporal network/coding rubric, fit simpler baselines, separate selection from influence and validate out of sample.
project_guides.downgrade_if: Contagion vanishes under exposure/selection controls or graph nonlocality is called quantum entanglement.

project_guides.meaning: Model-selection programme where group names earn value only through representations, breaking chains, thresholds and predictions.
project_guides.equation_focus: Run normalized gauge couplings and thresholds through one selected SU(5), Spin(10) or Pati-Salam chain.
project_guides.equation_meaning: Unification requires consistent embeddings and low-energy recovery, not merely listing larger symmetry groups.
project_guides.next_step: Choose one chain, specify complete reps/breaking fields and derive one quantitative observable.
project_guides.downgrade_if: Group/SUSY names accumulate without fields, scales, embeddings or predictions.

project_guides.meaning: Boundary-condition comparison between retarded/advanced Green functions, with retrocausal physics kept separate from future-oriented cognition.
project_guides.equation_focus: Solve the same wave/operator equation with retarded versus advanced boundary conditions.
project_guides.equation_meaning: The distinction concerns how a physical solution is selected from boundary data; planning around future goals is not an advanced physical wave.
project_guides.next_step: Solve one explicit comparator and define a measurable deviation from ordinary causal physics.
project_guides.downgrade_if: Psychological anticipation is used as evidence of advanced-wave causation.

project_guides.meaning: Type-safety exercise separating real quark charge/flavor facts from a symbolic ascent/grounding coordinate.
project_guides.equation_focus: Q_p/e=2/3+2/3-1/3=1; Q_n/e=2/3-1/3-1/3=0; symbolic p∈[-1,1] is a different variable.
project_guides.equation_meaning: Charge arithmetic is physical; project polarity is symbolic. A future physical Potato coupling requires explicit gauge-invariant operators.
project_guides.next_step: Choose P's field representation and enumerate lowest-dimension Lorentz/gauge-invariant quark operators.
project_guides.downgrade_if: Quark names are used as evidence for symbolic/moral polarity.

project_guides.meaning: Coupled biochemical stock-flow problem separating starch hydrolysis, fermentable sugar, fermentation and downstream separation.
project_guides.equation_meaning: Hydrolysis makes starch fermentable; fermentation converts sugars to ethanol/CO2; separate accounting reveals potato-derived versus added-sugar carbon.
project_guides.next_step: Measure hydrolysis/fermentation kinetics, carbon balance and yields in safe/legal experiments.
project_guides.downgrade_if: Yeast is modeled as directly fermenting intact starch or distillation is said to create ethanol.

cross_project_advancement_rule: Prefer the simplest model that preserves declared observables within tolerance. Richer ontology earns retention only when it reduces a named defect, creates a reproducible new prediction, enables intervention, or compresses multiple results without losing identifiability, correspondence limits or provenance clarity.
